info.name: Microsoft Entra ID Tenant ID - Detect
author: v0idc0de
tortuginator
info.description: Detected the Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) tenant ID behind a host. The target's pre-authentication redirect is checked first for a tenant GUID in the Location header or the Application Proxy x-ms-proxy-subscription-id header. If the target does not disclose the tenant, the host is resolved to its verified Azure AD domain through the login.microsoftonline.com userrealm endpoint and the tenant ID is read from the OpenID Connect discovery document.
